metaTitle: Custom Recycled Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled badge ID holders in bulk. Eco-friendly, durable, and perfect for your brand. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Made from post-consumer recycled materials, custom recycled badge ID holders offer a sustainable alternative for businesses that prioritize environmental responsibility without sacrificing durability. Ideal for trade shows, corporate events, or daily employee use, these holders feature clear PVC-free windows and reinforced edges to withstand frequent handling. Choose from vertical or horizontal orientations and add your logo via screen printing or debossing. They are lightweight, easy to clean, and compatible with standard lanyards or retractable reels.
